name: Sci-Plex HDAC-inhibitor subset, 3 cell lines by 4 drugs (GIM preprocessing)
description: Sci-Plex single-cell profiles of A549, K562 and MCF7 cells treated with belinostat, dacinostat, givinostat or quisinostat 2HCl at several doses, plus controls, preprocessed as in the GIM benchmark.

exact_manifest.note: No cell list or marker-gene list is published.

test_count.note: Cell counts per condition and the number of doses per drug are not printed.

attributes.reuse_note: Drawn from the same experiment as the store's two PerturBench Srivatsan20 subsets, lit-cells-networks-20261011-perturbench-v4-data-srivatsan20 and perturbench-dataset-srivatsan20, which are covariate-transfer splits to a held-out cell line over PerturBench's own compound selection. This is a different slice of those measurements: four HDAC inhibitors in three cell lines, GIM preprocessing, 50 marker genes per protocol and a dose holdout. No same_data_as link is recorded, because that relation is for subsets whose data are identical.

review.method_note: Independent review pass. Both pinned artifacts were re-downloaded and their SHA-256 checked against the source records, the mutable abstract page included, and both matched. A pdftotext -layout run (poppler 26.08.0) on the refetched PDF is byte for byte the contents of the archived gzipped text layer, so the archive is provably derived from the pinned bytes. npm run batch -- check-values reproduced the extractor's figures exactly (64 in_cell, 11 in_row, 6 locator_not_parsed, no wrong_column and no overclaimed_in_row) and wrote the same value-check.tsv. All 81 results were then re-read by review/recheck_tables.py, written for this pass and using neither extract/parse_tables.py nor extract/check_tables.py: it takes each table's column spans from the character offsets of that table's own printed header line, assigns every numeric token on a body line to the column whose header centre is nearest, and matches cells to records through each result's source_locator text rather than its ID, checking printed_value, numeric_value, the printed spread and the system the result's evaluation names. Two negative controls confirmed it fails on a swapped pair of values and on a cell shifted into the neighbouring column. A manual check of 16 cells covered column assignment in all three tables, including Table 2's unlabelled PerturbPFN score line, Table 1's third label and value pair on each of its three rows, and Table 3's middle columns. The printed overall score was re-derived as the equal-weight mean of each row's three normalised columns. The 54 descriptive records were read against Sections 2 to 5, Appendices A to E and Tables 4 to 8 of the pinned PDF.
review.reviewer_note: Claude review agent (independent of the extractor); no human review claimed. Transcription was checked against the pinned source; nothing was reproduced and no value was recomputed.

attributes.split: Per cell line and drug pair (12 protocols): the drug's highest dose is the query; context is the control cells, the drug's lower doses and all available doses of the other three drugs in the same cell line
attributes.subset_scope: Cell lines A549, K562, MCF7; drugs belinostat, dacinostat, givinostat, quisinostat 2HCl; all doses of these drugs and control cells
attributes.version: Preprocessed epigenetic-regulation benchmark of Schneider et al. 2025, as used in arXiv:2607.23447v1 Appendix D.1
